title: Cartwise Shopper Batches — Amount of an Approved Mileage Adjustment
content:
The mileage adjustment approved on a completed batch of Cartwise Shopper Batches is the amount claimed on the shopper's submitted mileage dispute, rounded to the cent half up; a claim below the batch type's minimum dispute amount is not adjusted and books nothing.

## Terms used

- **Amount claimed** — the amount stated on the shopper's submitted mileage dispute on the batch; where more than one such dispute stands submitted, the most recently submitted one.
- **Minimum dispute amount** — the batch type's smallest amount handled as a pay dispute. The test is made on the amount claimed; an amount equal to the minimum is not below it.
- **No submitted mileage dispute** — nothing is booked.

## Hypothetical cases (minimum of 1.00 assumed for illustration)

| Submitted mileage dispute | Amount claimed | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 3.47 | 3.47 |
| Yes | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| Yes | 0.60 | Nothing — below the minimum |
| None on the batch | — | Nothing |
